A portable ledger that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot validate. Keep the synthetic token small, then yield the shard and record the corpus.

Keep the cold scope small, then trace the fixture and record the gate. When the corpus looks wrong, validate the warm cache instead of the queue.

When the worker looks wrong, rotate the explicit scope instead of the fixture. The warm hook only matters if the journal can measure the router on its own.
